items.claim: CFO gave 2026 same-store revenue growth guidance in the mid-teen to high-teen percentage range.
items.quote: same-store revenue will rise by mid-teen to high-teen
items.speaker: Bill George, CFO

items.claim: CFO guided 2026 effective tax rate to approximately 23%, up from 20.9% in 2025.
items.quote: we estimate that our tax rate in 2026 will be around 23%
items.speaker: Bill George, CFO

items.claim: CFO stated Q4 gross profit percentage improved year over year to 25.5%.
items.quote: Our gross profit percentage grew to 25.5% this quarter
items.speaker: Bill George, CFO

items.claim: CFO reported Q4 SG&A expense at $248 million, or 9.4% of revenue, down from 11.1% a year ago.
items.speaker: Bill George, CFO

items.claim: CFO expressed optimism that gross profit margins would stay in recent strong ranges into 2026.
items.quote: gross profit margins will continue in the strong ranges
items.speaker: Bill George, CFO

items.claim: CEO described the company as the largest electrical contractor in Texas.
items.quote: we have the largest electrical contractor here in Texas
items.speaker: Brian Lane, CEO

items.claim: CFO claimed the company's pedigree in building data centers is unmatched industry-wide.
items.quote: nobody on the planet that has a better pedigree than us
items.speaker: Bill George, CFO

items.claim: CEO announced a quarterly dividend increase of $0.10 to $0.70 per share.
items.quote: increased our quarterly dividend by $0.10 to $0.70 per share
items.speaker: Brian Lane, CEO

items.claim: CFO reported over $200 million returned to shareholders via share repurchases in 2025.
items.quote: returned more than $200 million to shareholders
items.speaker: Bill George, CFO

items.claim: CFO said the company prioritizes acquisition conviction over spreadsheet-optimized pricing.
items.quote: We're going to stick with conviction.
items.speaker: Bill George, CFO

items.claim: CEO disclosed two electrical company acquisitions completed in Q4: FC in Michigan and Meisner in Florida.
items.speaker: Brian Lane, CEO

items.claim: CEO stated current modular capacity is around 3 million square feet.
items.quote: modular capacity is currently around 3 million square feet
items.speaker: Brian Lane, CEO

items.claim: CFO described investment in robotics and automation optimizations within modular facilities.
items.quote: robotics and other optimizations using automation
items.speaker: Bill George, CFO

items.claim: CFO said labor is the one cost category where the company bears risk on long-duration contracts, since equipment costs are quoted/locked early.
items.quote: we take all of our risk is labor
items.speaker: Bill George, CFO

items.claim: CFO confirmed some of the company's biggest operations had jobs shut down for multiple days in January due to weather.
items.quote: jobs shutdown for multiple days in January
items.speaker: Bill George, CFO

items.claim: CFO said the modular capacity expansion is primarily to meet demand from the company's 2 largest customers.
items.quote: meet more of the demand from our 2 largest customers
items.speaker: Bill George, CFO

items.claim: CEO said sequential backlog growth was especially strong from technology-sector customers.
items.quote: Backlog growth was especially strong with technology
items.speaker: Brian Lane, CEO

items.claim: CFO explained backlog is only booked once there is a binding legal commitment with a fixed price and scope.
items.quote: a binding legal commitment, a price and a scope
items.speaker: Bill George, CFO

items.claim: CFO said the single biggest space procurement for modular expansion will close at the end of February.
items.quote: procurement of space will close at the end of February
items.speaker: Bill George, CFO

qa_flags.question: And do you have a forecast for 2026 CapEx, Bill?
qa_flags.response_pattern: Declined to give a specific figure ('I really don't'), then hedged with a baseline percentage-of-revenue estimate instead of a dollar guidance number.

qa_flags.question: Did the two go hand in hand? Anything else that you would say is driving that operating leverage is it ultimately reflecting this benefit of the fixed overhead at modular this quarter?
qa_flags.response_pattern: Gave a general answer about execution and pricing, then explicitly said 'I don't know, maybe I didn't answer your first question' — self-acknowledged non-answer to the specific modular-vs-SG&A attribution question.
